# Toby Jackson — full page text

Toby Jackson
AI Solution Architect, builder of things.
Colorado Springs, CO

## Now

I just published Speaking Model (https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/),
a practitioner's dictionary for the working language between humans and AI
models — the verbs that act as contracts, the grammar of a complete request,
and the anti-patterns that feel powerful and aren't. It ships with a one-page
cheat sheet (https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/cheatsheet/) and a prompt
linter (https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/linter/) that runs entirely in
your browser. Source and Obsidian vault edition:
https://github.com/tobyjackson/speaking-model — licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Work

I run Infinite Sea, Inc. (https://infinite-sea.com), a software consultancy.
Most recently I spent several years as the sole architect and engineer on a
platform that moved a large company's core operations off a legacy AS400
mainframe and onto Go. Before that I led web development teams at a small web
agency and, further back, was in the Branch Technology department at a Wall
Street firm.

## Projects

Gapnop (https://github.com/tobyjackson/gapnop) — a minimalist, provider-agnostic agent
harness in Go, with session persistence, declarative skills, and MCP
integration. An experiment in building the whole loop myself, actively in
progress.
